integrity: The arbitrary finite-poset statement is proved analytically from normalized distances to the coordinate and cover halfspaces. Exhaustive computation through six elements is corroborative only and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem uses the standard coordinate Euclidean metric on the standard order-polytope realization; it does not cover arbitrary affine images, other norms, chain polytopes, John ellipsoids, or circumradii. Residual originality risk remains for unindexed or differently worded older metric literature.
title: Height determines the Euclidean inradius and centers of every order polytope
